API & MCP

Everything on this site comes from a public JSON API. AI agents can use the same queries over the Model Context Protocol.

HTTP API

Base URL http://127.0.0.1:62760 · interactive docs at /docs · OpenAPI at /openapi.json

GET /api/entries?q=&category=&kind=&grade=&format=&registry=&sort=&page=&size=Search and filter, with facet counts
GET /api/entries/{id}One entry: record, evaluation, adopters, imports, reuse, history, changes
GET /api/entries/{id}/historyScore, criteria and quality metrics in every run
GET /api/categoriesDomains with counts
GET /api/runsEvaluation runs, newest first
GET /api/runs/{id}One run, paginated per entry
GET /api/statsCatalog size, grades, average score
GET /api/metaSite, latest run and the scoring rubric

MCP server

Streamable HTTP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:62760/mcp/

Tools: search_catalog, get_entry, get_entry_history, list_categories, catalog_stats, scoring_rubric.

Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http neuroschema http://127.0.0.1:62760/mcp/

A curated, automatically evaluated catalog of neuroscience ontologies, schemas, vocabularies and data standards.
